prompt: Create a responsive website homepage visual for a corporate site with the theme: 'Telling the story of a manufacturing company that makes recyclable materials as a modern workshop that breathes slowly.' The image is not a traditional industrial site but a horizontal hero section visual: the foreground features neatly cut recyclable material samples, embossed boards, pulp molded parts, and metal fixtures; the middle ground is a translucent data card and brand title; the background is a modern workshop space with controlled lighting. The composition uses a desktop Hero ratio, with an information area on the left, product/material display on the right, and clear navigation spacing at the top, while naturally extending to a mobile hero screen. Lighting is a mix of large-scale skylight and a few warm work lights, highlighting material textures, cross-sectional structures, and brand credibility. The color system must include specific hex codes: Pulp Cream #E9E1D4, Workshop Grey #A9ACA8, Deep Olive Green #66715F, Metallic Grey-Blue #8897A0, Structural Brown #8B7058, Title Charcoal Black #2C2F31. Focus on describing fiber embossing, cut edges, metal fixtures, frosted acrylic, and workshop tabletop scratches. Requires a small amount of Chinese-led text, including the company name, core value proposition, a very short English auxiliary phrase, and two functional labels, with the layout serving the website hierarchy.

promptZh: 创建一个响应式网站首页视觉图，主题为：“讲述一家制造 可回收材料 的企业故事，将其呈现为一个呼吸感十足的现代工坊。” 该图像并非传统的工业现场，而是一个横向的 Hero 区视觉图：前景展示整齐切割的可回收材料样本、压纹项目、纸浆模塑件及金属固定件；中景为半透明数据卡片与品牌标题；背景为光线可控的现代工坊空间。构图采用桌面端 Hero 比例，左侧为信息区，右侧为产品/材料展示区，顶部留有清晰的导航间距，并能自然适配移动端 Hero 屏幕。灯光结合了大面积天窗光与少量暖色工作灯，突显材料纹理、横截面结构及品牌可信度。配色方案需包含以下十六进制色值：纸浆奶油色 #E9E1D4、工坊灰 #A9ACA8、深橄榄绿 #66715F、金属蓝灰 #8897A0、结构棕 #8B7058、标题炭黑 #2C2F31。重点描述纤维压纹、切割边缘、金属固定件、磨砂亚克力及工坊桌面划痕。需要包含少量中文主导的文字，包括公司名称、核心价值主张、一句极简的英文辅助短语以及两个功能标签，布局需服务于网站的层级结构。
